record.question: God defends the right! Identify the part of speech of the underlined word.
record.explanation: Answer C: Noun. “The right” means what is morally correct; “right” is a noun. Independent check: “The right” is a nominalized adjective meaning justice or what is morally correct; here it functions as a noun.
